title: Buyer's Agent Access to Mortgage Pre-Approval Information
content:
A borrower may name a buyer's real estate agent on a Mortgage Pre-Approval. What that named agent may do, and what Larkspur Home Lending may tell an authorized agent, depends on the pre-approval level.

## Agent access by level

| Level | Named agent may request letters | Agent letter requests need the borrower's sharing authorization on file | What Larkspur may tell an authorized agent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | No | Yes | status; expiration date |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | status; expiration date; letter purchase price |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | status; expiration date; letter purchase price |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | status; expiration date; letter purchase price |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | status; expiration date; letter purchase price |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | status; expiration date; letter purchase price |

## Terms used in this guide

- **Named agent may request letters**: whether the agent named on the pre-approval may request letters.
- **Sharing authorization on file**: whether agent letter requests need the borrower's sharing authorization on file. The sharing authorization is the borrower's authorization for Larkspur to share letters and the expiration date with the named agent and to take letter requests from that agent.
- **What Larkspur may tell an authorized agent**: the items Larkspur may tell an authorized agent. The status is the pre-approval's current status; the expiration date is the last day the pre-approval and its letters are valid; the letter purchase price is the purchase price stated on a letter.

## Agent guide notes

- Under a Larkspur Pre-Qualification the named agent cannot request letters, and an authorized agent may be told the status and the expiration date only.
- Under the other five levels the named agent may request letters, and an authorized agent may also be told the letter purchase price.
- At every level, an agent's letter request needs the borrower's sharing authorization on file.
